# Selected original dsh-context dashboard

Public source: [bowenliang123/dsh-context](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context/tree/2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499), version **0.68.1**, commit **2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499**. Original **Copyright 2025 bowenliang123** and [Apache 2.0](LICENSE) apply to the selected supplier files. The inspected commit has no separate NOTICE file. They are not MIT and Augmentor’s resale restriction does not replace their licence.

SOURCE.json records every selected file’s original/adapted SHA-256. Ninety-eight files are selected; eleven presentation modules carry prominent change notices: disable automatic registry checks and an unbound DSH settings shortcut, remove an unattested DSH compaction threshold, mark unobserved skill/fleet data unavailable, and bind the original request selector to explicit Pi metadata paging/body reads with unavailable-data notes. The original slash modal also receives the same picker and a recorded-data notice. The original Insights overview uses independently authored bounded Pi corpus reads, keeps calendar/range/search/sort/group/paging/navigation/chart/heatmap structure, displays reported SDK usage buckets instead of inferred historical composition, disables DSH backfill and marks unavailable skills/prices/detailed timing explicitly. The tooltip captures stable identity outside React state updaters to prevent heatmap focus/measurement loops; its original markup and CSS remain unchanged. Cards, charts, browser, dialog interactions and CSS retain the supplier structure. Unused selected modules never enter the browser graph.

Build-time module resolution binds historyPage and modelPrices to independently authored read-only Pi glue. Inline projections supply retained Pi observations; there is no supplier plugin Host, Cordis runtime, extra agent/session loop, external price/registry fetch or DSH history route in the browser graph. Tailwind 4.3.3 generates the supplier utility CSS using the original source and pinned build-only compiler; its MIT notice is included separately in the bundled notices.

See [qualification and coverage](../../../../docs/DSH-GUI-ON-PI.md#original-context-dashboard--october-11-follow-up). The Context tab and original slash modal share read-only Pi projections. Context Insights has a retained-data Pi adapter; Fleet, right-sidebar placement, delegated-child attribution and persistent plugin preferences remain unported.
